summary: Agents can query an exact nearest contour attachment and check its straight entry against all source segments without copying the drawing or editing machining intent.
warning: A clear approach reports source-geometry intersections only. It does not account for wire radius, fixtures, material access or machine certification. A blocked nearest point does not rule out alternatives. Installed posts and saved revisions are unchanged.

checklist.schema: Adds read-only edm_inspect_approach. No UPID, project, revision, machine-package or post schema changes.
checklist.events: No execution-event or mutation changes. The query shares existing exact snapping and source lead-intersection operations.
checklist.capabilities: No machine or post capability changes. Results pin the target version and paginate complete source-contact checks.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No controller generation, auditing or output changes. The query does not review or authorize machining intent.
checklist.installationAndStorage: Read-only for browser and folder projects. No installation, migration or writes to originals/posts/revisions.
checklist.verification: 15 focused domain/public-query tests pass: exact circular nearest attachment, obstructing contours, hinted/zero-length cases, all 4,363 polygon segments, complete-contact pagination, missing IDs and stale-version rejection. Chromium checks clear and blocked approaches without modifying the draft. Native TypeScript, full production build, lint and UI checks pass. Software checks do not establish physical machine verification.
